_source: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.43 schematic (files.waveshare.com, 2024): J1/J2/J3/J4/J7 nets re-verified 2026-10-24 against the PDF's own netlist layer by tests/schematic_netlist_check.py

J7.note: 1S LiPo MX1.25 header - LEFT EMPTY in M6 (no main battery)

harness.via: Bourns MF-R075 PTC (hold 0.75 A, trip 1.5 A, 60 V, R1max 0.60 ohm)

buzzer_driver.R1: 100 ohm 1/4 W: IO16 -> Q1 gate (edge-rate / ringing damper)
buzzer_driver.R2: 100 kohm 1/4 W: Q1 gate -> source/GND (off through reset, boot and when the socket is unplugged)
buzzer_driver.Q1: AO3400A N-MOSFET, SOT-23 on a SOT-23-to-DIP adapter: drain -> buzzer -, source -> GND. VGS(th) 0.65-1.45 V; RDS(on) < 48 mohm guaranteed at VGS 2.5 V; VDS 30 V; VGS +/-12 V
buzzer_driver.D1: 1N4148 across the buzzer coil, cathode to +5 V (clamps the coil flyback to ~5.7 V)
buzzer_driver.BZ: Soberton WT-1205 passive magnetic transducer, 5 V (4-6 Vo-p), coil 47 +/-7 ohm, 50 mA max mean, 2400 Hz, d12.0 x 9.5 mm +/-0.5, pins 6.5 mm (Digi-Key 433-1028-ND)
buzzer_driver.why_not_2N3904: 2N3904 saturation is only specified to IC 50 mA with IB 5 mA (VCE(sat) <= 0.3 V); the WT-1205 coil can peak at 5.25 V / 40 ohm = 131 mA, where only active-region hFE >= 30 at VCE 1 V is given, and a 3.3 V GPIO cannot supply a forced-beta-10 base current (13 mA).

rtc_backup: EXCLUDED from M6 purchase: J2 is charged from 3V3 through B5819 with no current limit; no cell until charge voltage/current are validated (G1-E3 + datasheet). Without it the clock is restored by phone time_sync after any power cut.
dual_port_rule: Never connect the board's own USB-C and the external port at the same time: their VBUS (USB_5V) and D+/D- are the same nets. The board port is only reachable with the upper shell removed; label it.

adafruit_4090_pins.4: CC1 (5.1k to GND on board, n/c)
adafruit_4090_pins.8: CC2 (5.1k to GND on board, n/c)

strain_relief: Zip-tie the harness bundle to the rear M3 column (y=+26) 40 mm from the breakout; dab hot-melt over the 4090 solder pads; keep D+/D- 10 mm away from the buzzer wires.
